title: My Husband Ordered Me to Take Care of His Friend and Her Newborn for Six Months. I Agreed With a Smile—Until the Doorbell Rang and Everything Changed.

blocks.text: The evening Gavin announced that another woman would be moving into our house for six months, he didn’t even have the courtesy to put down his phone.

“My friend Selena just had a baby,” he said, scrolling through his messages. “She’s going through a difficult time, so she’s moving in with us on Saturday. You’ll need to take care of her and the baby.”
I stood across from him at the kitchen island.
For a moment, I honestly thought I had misunderstood.
“Don’t start, Claire. Selena needs somewhere comfortable to stay. She has a newborn, and she can’t manage everything alone.”
“And why exactly is she moving into our house?”
That was Gavin. He didn’t ask for permission. He announced decisions and expected everyone around him to adjust.
We had been married for eight years. During those years, I had slowly become responsible for almost everything in our household.
I handled the bills, cleaned the house, organized his appointments, prepared his meals, and remembered every birthday in his family.
He wasn’t asking me to accommodate a friend for a weekend.
He was inviting another woman and her newborn to occupy our home for half a year.
“And what about my work?” I asked. “My schedule? My privacy?”
“Claire, you’re working from home. It’s not like you have somewhere important to be.”
“Why would I? You’re my wife. I thought you’d understand.”
Then he added something that made my stomach tighten.
“Besides, Selena has been through enough. Don’t make her feel unwelcome.”
“Absolutely, sweetheart. I’ll make sure everything is ready.”
Gavin’s expression softened immediately.
He kissed my forehead and walked upstairs.
I remained in the kitchen, listening to his footsteps disappear.
Because Gavin had made one enormous mistake.
He had mistaken my silence for helplessness. 1. The woman who believed my house belonged to her Saturday morning arrived.
At 9:15, a black SUV pulled into our driveway.
Selena stepped out wearing oversized sunglasses, an expensive-looking coat, and an expression that suggested she was arriving at a luxury hotel.
And enough boxes to make it look like she was relocating permanently.
He hugged her and immediately reached for the baby carrier.
Something about the way they interacted made me uncomfortable.
It wasn’t the warmth of an old friendship.
It was the familiarity of two people who had been sharing a secret.
She approached and gave me a quick, almost theatrical hug.
“Thank you so much for letting me stay. Gavin says you’re wonderful at taking care of everything.”
“I was thinking the guest bedroom would be perfect. But honestly, I’d prefer the master bedroom because it’s closer to the bathroom. Newborns are exhausting, you know.”
“Yes. Gavin said we could rearrange things.”
Selena continued as if the decision had already been finalized.
“And we’ll need some space for the baby’s things. Maybe you could move your office into the smaller room?”
These two hadn’t arrived expecting hospitality.
“Nothing. Come inside. We have a little surprise waiting.” 2. The six-month arrangement Before explaining what happened next, there’s something you should know about Gavin.
He had become increasingly controlling over the previous year.
He started questioning my purchases, criticizing my friends, and insisting that every major household decision should go through him.
He also began spending unusually long hours away from home.
Whenever I asked questions, he accused me of being suspicious.
Then, three weeks before his announcement, I discovered something strange.
A large transfer had been made from our joint household account.
The payment description mentioned a private accommodation arrangement.
When I confronted Gavin, he claimed it was a business expense.
I checked the account records more carefully and discovered several smaller transfers to an account associated with Selena.
I also found messages on an old tablet Gavin had forgotten to log out of.
“Once I’m there, she’ll have no choice. You promised me everything would be different.”
“Just get through the first few weeks. Claire will eventually accept it.”
“Don’t worry. I know how to handle Claire.”
That was when I stopped trying to understand his behavior and started protecting myself.
I gathered copies of the documents relating to our property.
And I discovered that Gavin had been discussing a plan to refinance our house using paperwork he had prepared without my knowledge.
He was counting on me to sign whatever he placed in front of me.
He had no idea I had already contacted the bank and requested that no changes involving my ownership interest proceed without proper verification.
I had discovered who Selena really was. 3. The doorbell Back in the living room, Selena was already directing the movers.
“Gavin, could you help me move the dresser?”
“Before everyone gets too comfortable,” I announced, “there’s someone I’d like you both to meet.”
